A conceptual diagram illustrating the OILRIG mnemonic. On the left side, a blue circle labelled 'Atom A' with an arrow pointing outward, tossing a small yellow sphere labelled 'e⁻' (electron) to the right. Text above reads "Oxidation Is Loss (OIL)". On the right side, a red circle labelled 'Atom B' catching the 'e⁻'. Text above reads "Reduction Is Gain (RIG)". Clean flat textbook illustration style, white background.

A laboratory setup for testing a reducing agent. A test tube held securely by a clamp contains a colourless solution of sulphur(IV) oxide in water (a reducing agent). Above it, a dropping pipette is adding drops of a purple acidified potassium tetraoxomanganate(VII) solution. An arrow points from the purple drops falling into the colourless solution with a text label reading: "Purple KMnO4 turns colourless as it is reduced by the reducing agent". Clean flat textbook illustration style, white background.
